capabilities: Browse and search a nested page tree in the sidebar
Create, rename, move and reorder pages from the sidebar
Embed child pages in a note as a list or card grid
Move a parent note into a matching folder when it gets children
Install an agent skill that writes note organization rules
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or newer on desktop and mobile; the optional agent skill installs a guide in the vault and adds an editable section to AGENTS.md.
intentEvidence: Browse and search your page tree alongside Obsidian’s file explorer.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows folders and files without a parent/child page hierarchy, and a note cannot display its own child pages as a browsable list.
summary: Sidebar tree that organizes notes as nested parent and child pages, with child-page lists or card grids embedded inside notes.
